name: vsftpd 2.3.4 - Backdoor Command Execution
description: vsftpd 2.3.4 downloaded from the master site between 2011-06-30 and 2011-07-01 contains a backdoor: a username ending in ':)' opens a root shell on TCP 6200.
remediation: Replace the binary with a clean vsftpd build from your distribution's packages and verify its checksum.
